description.p: Abuse is a run-and-gun side-scroller released as shareware by Crack dot Com in 1995. It is remembered for one idea: the keyboard runs and jumps while the mouse aims, completely independently, so you can sprint one way and fire another. Almost nothing in 1995 could do that.

You are Nick Vrenna, imprisoned in a facility where the staff run medical experiments on the inmates. One of those experiments, a substance the project calls Abuse, escapes during a riot and takes the prison. Nick is immune, and the contagion is about to reach the water supply.
This port runs the game on current hardware and systems:

ul.li: SDL3, with scale modes, filtering, vsync and an FPS limit
A fixed 15 Hz simulation, so every machine plays the same game
Gamepad support, with aiming on the right stick and rumble
A user interface drawn at the display's own resolution
English, French, German and Brazilian Portuguese
Optional lighting, widescreen, scanlines and particles

description.p: Two modes are offered at startup. Original plays the 1995 game with its own data and rules, untouched. Remastered is where everything new goes, and none of it is compulsory.

The original sound effects and music are not free to redistribute and are not included. The game downloads them on request, with the checksums pinned, for anyone who wants the Original mode with audio.
